Chadikar, Vengo Lord, and Prince Vhordrai all walk into a bar. The bartender asks, "What'll it be, gents?"

Chadikar grunts, "A pint of A-positive, keeps the veins pumping. "Vengo Lord says, "O-negative for me." Prince Vhordrai flashes his fangs and cackles, "B-positive, barkeep, because I heard that jerk Nagash is back from the dead and need to stay optimistic that there will be real change around here."
